verdict.rationale: Supabase's Realtime docs explicitly offer 'Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time,' and the GitHub README lists 'Realtime subscriptions' as an auto-generated API. Broadcast is also documented for pushing database changes to clients, and the CEO describes the production Elixir/Phoenix Realtime server, so a UI can update live without polling. Missing for 10: client-side subscription code or filter documentation in the pack, hands-on or independent corroboration that Postgres Changes subscriptions work in practice (the community item covers Broadcast/Presence, not Postgres Changes), and evidence of how authorization/RLS applies to realtime streams.
